evidence: Receiving DO2 online sensor: ~11.3-12.9 mg/L at t=51-52h, far above 2 mg/L limit
Receiving DO2 minimum observed: 8.6 mg/L at t=123h
Receiving product assays: 0.038 g/L (t=119h), 1.067 g/L (t=179h), 2.945 g/L (t=239h) - healthy growth
Source batches (calibration reference) show DO never below ~7.4 mg/L across full 96h observed window, including demand peaks at t=119h and t=373h
submission.rationale: Receiving fermentation is in a normal operating regime at the decision time (t=52h): DO is 11-13 mg/L with a >9 mg/L margin over the 2 mg/L hard limit, and product concentration is rising steadily (0.038 -> 1.067 -> 2.945 g/L). The receiving trajectory matches the source-batch pattern, in which DO dipped only to ~7.4-8.7 mg/L at peak oxygen demand. Feed reduction or stronger measures would needlessly sacrifice product mass; increase_air is unnecessary. KEEP preserves full production with no predicted constraint risk.
submission.uncertainty: The receiving process may differ from the source (hidden parameters), so future DO minima are not guaranteed; however, the margin (>=6 mg/L in all observed analog trajectories) is large relative to plausible forecast error. If a future oxygen demand peak were far stronger than in the source batches, a later intervention might be needed, but current evidence does not support one.
